description: This source file defines the CustomerGrain class, which is an Orleans grain implementing customer-related logic and state management, including setting customer details, adding devices, and initializing random state data.

classes.name: CustomerGrain
classes.description: An Orleans grain class managing customer state and behaviors, utilizing a storage provider.

methods.description: Handles grain activation, possibly initializing state.
